text.title: 故事之间的广告
text.situation:
一位读者的留言放在两份广告样张旁。读者喜欢节目，却因反复看到同一广告而产生广告疲劳。诺拉在留言上贴醒目的蓝标签，免得被校样盖住。她们讨论广告饱和，以及广告拦截技术对小刊物收入的影响。一份样张以读者价值为导向：先提供实用指南，再介绍产品。另一份不断重复一位名人的脸。乔认为，过多宣传可能导致过度曝光，却没给读者有用内容。诺拉没有把这段讨论硬塞进大厅文章，而是留到出版会议，以实际反馈比较，不假定所有读者感受相同。

乔：这位读者说，重复的广告让自己厌倦了。
诺拉：把留言放在能看见的地方。
乔：我贴了醒目的标签。
诺拉：出版会议时再比较反馈。

paragraphs.en: A reader’s message lay beside two advertising samples. The reader had liked the programme but felt ad fatigue after seeing the same advert several times. Nora placed a conspicuous blue tab on the message so it would not disappear under the proofs. They discussed advertising saturation and the effect of ad-blocking technology on a small publication’s income. One sample offered value-driven content: a practical guide that helped readers before introducing a product. The other repeated a celebrity’s face. Too much publicity could lead to overexposure, Jo suggested, without giving readers anything useful. Nora kept the discussion separate from the article about the hall. The question belonged in their publishing meeting, where they could compare actual responses rather than assume every reader felt the same.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: The reader says the repeated advert caused ad fatigue.
Nora: Keep the message where we can see it.
Jo: I have put a conspicuous tab on it.
Nora: Let’s compare the responses at the publishing meeting.
